source_spec: COLOR GRADING PRESETS SPECIFICATION FOR FREEDIVING FOOTAGE (DJI Action D-Log M 10-bit)

conventions.hsl.hue_deg: do xoay hue (degrees), am = xoay ve phia cyan/teal
conventions.hsl_bands: 7 kenh: red(0), orange(30), yellow(60), green(120), cyan(180), blue(240), magenta(300) — mo rong tu 6 kenh trong kien truc de giu nguyen gia tri Orange cua spec (DEVIATION ghi nhan)
conventions.calibration_note: Cac gia tri dinh tinh trong spec (High Warm, High Magenta, slightly...) duoc luong hoa theo thang chuan duoi day va co the tinh chinh khi test tren footage that: High=0.50-0.60, Moderate=0.30-0.40, Slight=0.10

anti_green.description: Khu am xanh la (kieu Anti-Green cua LumaFusion) — slider toan cuc, xep chong len moi preset, khong thuoc tham so preset
anti_green.pipeline_stage: pre_lut — sau White Balance/Tint, truoc Red Channel Recovery
anti_green.algorithm: Thich nghi theo pixel, bao toan luma: gExcess = max(G - max(R,B), 0); G' = G - strength*gExcess; scale toan pixel ve luma goc. Chi tac dong pixel co G troi (green cast), khong cham pixel xanh duong thuan.
anti_green.recommended_note: Gia tri khoi diem de xuat (preset Phu Quoc da bu green manh bang Tint +0.50 nen chi can thap; Deep Sea Blue khong co green cast nen de 0) — tinh chinh khi test footage that
anti_green.ui_hint: Chip bat/tat nhanh 'Anti-Green' (dat 0.5) + slider tinh chinh trong panel Layer 1; haptic tick tai moc 0

layer_visibility.description: Icon con mat tren tung layer (Core Features #1): bypass hieu ung de so sanh Before/After ma KHONG mat gia tri slider

keyframing.description: Depth-based Keyframing (Core Features #4): noi suy tham so grade frame-by-frame theo tien trinh clip — vi du tho lan di len tu 25m ve mat nuoc
keyframing.engine: Noi suy TUYEN TINH phia CPU bang fdc::Evaluate/Lerp (freediving_color_presets.h), day ket qua xuong GPU qua UBO moi frame; shader khong doi

keyframe_schema.time_sec: double — vi tri keyframe tren clip
keyframe_schema.params: toan bo pre_lut + lut_engine.intensity + post_lut + anti_green deu keyframe duoc; truong bool giu gia tri keyframe dau

environment.notes: Day cat nui lua toi, vach drop-off kich tinh, dong chay kho luong, nhiet do nuoc pha tron

presets.aesthetic_goal: Bat mat, tuoi sang, than thien CapCut — khach tour dang mang xa hoi ngay; tone da nay no, nuoc song dong

lut_engine.intensity_note: Grade Co LUT clamp 85% de giu tu nhien

post_lut.skin_tone_protection_note: Khoa hue-shift va gioi han sat-shift trong dai hue 15..45 do (Orange/Red) de bao ve tone da
